boundaries.name: solidity_abi_and_memory
boundaries.obligation: Successful Solidity0.8.24 ABI decoding yields modeled bounded arguments. Private output blocks refine fresh allocated array writes/cursor increments and decode(bytes32) on exactly32 bytes matches canonical serialization. Compiler/memory/revert-byte equivalence not proved.

boundaries.name: evm_static_calls_and_code
boundaries.obligation: EvmView observations must be actual read-only calls for the indexed adapter/core in the same immutable deployment. Return/revert paths are modeled, not code/config/VK authenticity or underlying staticcall implementation.

boundaries.name: keccak_and_packed_encoding
boundaries.obligation: beBytes fixed-width BE packing corresponds to actual Solidity abi.encodePacked and Keccak implements Keccak256. Collision resistance and composite state/statement binding remain external.

boundaries.name: proof_and_payout_authority
boundaries.obligation: Dedicated adapters must provide actual proof soundness; Manager injects authentic finalized channel/member/recipient context and composes public close binder with its pinned adapter. Plaintext, registry, nullifier and ownership relations are circuit/Manager dependencies.

boundaries.name: disabled_caller_authority
boundaries.obligation: Special/late verifier endpoints are Bool digest stubs; Manager disabled callers must remain unable to use them for value authorization.

boundaries.name: resource_and_compiler_refinement
boundaries.obligation: Gas/allocation/OOG, ABI parser internals and compiled-source equivalence are not proved; pure model computations omit resource exhaustion.
